# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Executes one complete TDD cycle with GREEN retries and learning loop |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | Language-specific pod that delegates code generation and test execution |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase using LLM and playbook context |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment based on current state |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer with security hash verification |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Rootless Podman container runner for isolated test execution |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook creation, delta updates, and bullet retrieval |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD cycles and ML experiments to PostgreSQL/SQLite |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified client for multiple LLM providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, etc.) |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes generator performance and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant playbook bullets |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Checks generated code for forbidden imports and builtins |
| ContextMapBuilder | src/utils/context_map.py | Builds AST-based context map from source files |
| ContextMap | src/utils/context_map.py | Stores AST signatures and provides relevance queries |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src/analytics/token_efficiency.py | Computes token efficiency scores across language pods |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src/analytics/success_rate_calculator.py | Measures experiment success rates by type and version |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates agent performance metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| BrokerAdvisor | src/broker/advisor.py | Recommends agents by capability fit |
| CapabilityRegistry | src/broker/capability_registry.py | Tracks anonymous agent capabilities and proficiency |
| AuditClient | src/audit/client.py | Write-only audit client for emitting events |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store.py | Append-only audit store with hash chain integrity |
| EnsembleLearner | src/ensemble/learner.py | Orchestrates multi-model learning with voting and deliberation |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router.py | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for code generation |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src/agents/autonomous_tdd_agent.py | Full autonomous TDD agent with ensemble learning and test review |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Drives TDD loops across multiple language pods |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Filter as ImportFilter
    participant Orch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant PB as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflect as Reflector
    participant Curate as Curator

    User->>Runner: run(feature)
    loop for each cycle
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement

        Runner->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        LLM-->>Worker: code
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        Pod->>Filter: check(test_code)
        alt forbidden import
            Filter-->>Pod: ForbiddenImportError
            Pod-->>Runner: PhaseResult(error="ForbiddenImport:...")
            Runner-->>User: CycleResult(success=False)
            break
        end
        Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file: code})
        Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        Container-->>Orch: PulseResult
        Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        Pod-->>Runner: red_result

        alt red aborted (security)
            Runner-->>User: CycleResult(success=False)
            break
        end

        loop up to max_green_attempts
            Runner->>Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec)
            Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
            LLM-->>Worker: code
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            Pod->>Filter: check(impl_code)
            alt forbidden import
                Filter-->>Pod: ForbiddenImportError
                Pod-->>Runner: PhaseResult(error="ForbiddenImport:...")
                break
            end
            Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
            Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
            Container-->>Orch: PulseResult
            Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            Pod-->>Runner: green_result
            alt green passed
                break
            else
                Note right of Runner: set error_feedback from output
            end
        end

        alt green failed
            Runner-->>User: CycleResult(success=False)
            break
        end

        Runner->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
        Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
        Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        Container-->>Orch: PulseResult
        Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        Pod-->>Runner: refactor_result

        alt refactor passed
            opt learning loop enabled
                Runner->>Reflect: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                Reflect-->>Runner: ReflectorOutput
                Runner->>Curate: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                Curate->>PB: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                PB-->>Curate: added_bullets
                Curate-->>Runner: CuratorOutput
            end
        else
            Note right of Runner: cycle considered failed
        end

        Runner->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(cycle_data)
        Logger-->>Runner: ok
    end
    Runner-->>User: IterativeResult
```
